```{r}

########################################### analysis part ##########################################################
#Create Period
hms_did_small <- hms_did_small %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert to uniform datetime format by checking the pattern
    startdate_parsed = case_when(
      grepl("/", startdate) ~ ymd_hm(startdate),          # YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM
      grepl("-", startdate) ~ ymd_hms(startdate),         # YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
      TRUE ~ NA_POSIXct_                                   # fallback for unexpected format
    ),
    
    # Extract survey year
    survey_wave = year(startdate_parsed),

    # Define period based on year
    period = case_when(
      survey_wave %in% c(2021,2022) ~ "during",
      survey_wave %in% c(2023, 2024) ~ "after"
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("during", "after"))
  )

```

```{r}
table(hms_did_small$period)
```

```{r}
# Create groups
hms_did_small <- hms_did_small %>%
  mutate(
    diagnostic_group = case_when(
      dep_any == 1 & anx_any == 0 ~ "Depression only",
      dep_any == 0 & anx_any == 1 ~ "Anxiety only",
      dep_any == 1 & anx_any == 1 ~ "Comorbid",
      dep_any == 0 & anx_any == 0 ~ "Neither"
    ),
    diagnostic_group = factor(diagnostic_group,
                              levels = c("Neither", "Depression only", "Anxiety only", "Comorbid"))
  )
```

```{r}
# Create survey design object
hms_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~nrweight,
  data = hms_did_small
)
```

```{r}
# did model with PHQ9 depression
```

```{r}
compute_table_by_year <- function(df, year) {
  df_year <- df %>%
    filter(survey_wave == year) %>%
    mutate(
      group_dep_only = as.numeric(diagnostic_group == "Depression only"),
      group_anx_only = as.numeric(diagnostic_group == "Anxiety only"),
      group_comorbid = as.numeric(diagnostic_group == "Comorbid"),
      group_neither = as.numeric(diagnostic_group == "Neither")
    )

  design_year <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~nrweight, data = df_year)

  prev <- svymean(~group_dep_only + group_anx_only + group_comorbid + group_neither,
                  design_year, na.rm = TRUE)

  prevalence_df <- as.data.frame(prev)
  prevalence_df$diagnostic_group <- rownames(prevalence_df)

  prevalence_df <- prevalence_df %>%
    select(diagnostic_group, Prevalence = mean, SE = SE) %>%
    mutate(
      diagnostic_group = gsub("group_", "", diagnostic_group),
      CI_Lower = Prevalence - 1.96 * SE,
      CI_Upper = Prevalence + 1.96 * SE,
      Year = year  # ADD YEAR here
    )

  return(prevalence_df)
}

# Run for all years and combine into one data frame
years <- c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
yearly_tables <- purrr::map_dfr(years, ~ compute_table_by_year(hms_did_small, .x))

```

```{r}
# Define helper function
get_treatment_by_year <- function(df, year) {
  df_year <- df %>%
    filter(survey_wave == year)

  # Create survey design for that year
  design_year <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~nrweight, data = df_year)

  # Function to get one treatment type
  get_svyby_with_ci <- function(varname, label) {
    svyby(as.formula(paste0("~", varname)), ~diagnostic_group, design_year, svymean,
          keep.var = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
      rename(!!label := !!sym(varname), SE = se) %>%
      mutate(
        CI_Lower = !!sym(label) - 1.96 * SE,
        CI_Upper = !!sym(label) + 1.96 * SE,
        Year = year
      ) %>%
      select(diagnostic_group, Year, !!label, SE, CI_Lower, CI_Upper)
  }

  # Compute all treatment types
  therapy    <- get_svyby_with_ci("ther_any", "Therapy")
  medication <- get_svyby_with_ci("meds_any", "Medication")
  combined   <- get_svyby_with_ci("tx_any",   "Combined")

  # Merge all into one table
  therapy %>%
    left_join(medication, by = c("diagnostic_group", "Year"), suffix = c("_therapy", "_meds")) %>%
    left_join(combined,  by = c("diagnostic_group", "Year"), suffix = c("", "_combined"))
}

# Apply across years
years <- c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

treatment_by_year <- map_dfr(years, ~ get_treatment_by_year(hms_did_small, .x))

# View final result
print(treatment_by_year)

```




```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Create the plot with estimates and SEs
plot_prevalence <- ggplot(yearly_tables, aes(x = Year, y = Prevalence, color = diagnostic_group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_Lower, ymax = CI_Upper),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                width = 0.2) +
  # Add prevalence estimates as text
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Prevalence * 100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
            vjust = -1.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence by Diagnostic Group and Year",
    x = "Year", y = "Estimated Prevalence",
    color = "Diagnostic Group"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 0.7)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

# Show the plot
print(plot_prevalence)



```

```{r}
plot_treatment_type <- function(df, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = Rate, color = diagnostic_group)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_Lower, ymax = CI_Upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.2) +
    
    # Prevalence % labels shifted further above the point and bar
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Rate * 100, 1), "%")),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
              vjust = -3, size = 3, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(title, " Treatment Usage by Group and Year"),
      x = "Year", y = "Usage Rate", color = "Diagnostic Group"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0.1, 0.75)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
}
```

```{r}
# Therapy plot

# Combined plot

# Show plots
print(plot_therapy)
print(plot_medication)
print(plot_combined)
```

```{r}
################################Compare adjust by design weight or not##############################################
library(purrr)

# Function to compare unweighted vs weighted prevalence for a given year
compare_prevalence_by_year <- function(df, year) {
  df_year <- df %>%
    filter(survey_wave == year) %>%
    mutate(
      group_dep_only = diagnostic_group == "Depression only",
      group_anx_only = diagnostic_group == "Anxiety only",
      group_comorbid = diagnostic_group == "Comorbid",
      group_neither = diagnostic_group == "Neither"
    )

  # --- Unweighted ---
  unweighted <- tibble(
    Group = c("Depression only", "Anxiety only", "Comorbid", "Neither"),
    Est = c(
      mean(df_year$group_dep_only, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(df_year$group_anx_only, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(df_year$group_comorbid, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(df_year$group_neither, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    SE = c(
      sd(df_year$group_dep_only, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(df_year$group_dep_only))),
      sd(df_year$group_anx_only, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(df_year$group_anx_only))),
      sd(df_year$group_comorbid, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(df_year$group_comorbid))),
      sd(df_year$group_neither, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(df_year$group_neither)))
    ),
    Type = "Unweighted",
    Year = year
  )

  # --- Weighted ---
  df_year <- df_year %>%
    mutate(
      group_dep_only = as.numeric(group_dep_only),
      group_anx_only = as.numeric(group_anx_only),
      group_comorbid = as.numeric(group_comorbid),
      group_neither = as.numeric(group_neither)
    )

  design_year <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~nrweight, data = df_year)
  design_year <- update(design_year, group_dep_only, group_anx_only, group_comorbid, group_neither)

  weighted <- svymean(~group_dep_only + group_anx_only + group_comorbid + group_neither,
                      design = design_year, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      Group = gsub("group_", "", rownames(.)),
      Type = "Weighted",
      Year = year
    ) %>%
    rename(Est = mean, SE = SE) %>%
    select(Group, Est, SE, Type, Year)

  # Combine and return
  bind_rows(unweighted, weighted)
}

# Years to compare
years <- c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

# Run for all years
prevalence_comparison_all <- map_dfr(years, ~ compare_prevalence_by_year(hms_did_small, .x))

# View the result
print(prevalence_comparison_all)

write.csv(prevalence_comparison_all, "D:/survey sample/compare.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
